exposure: Cell-free DNA noninvasive prenatal single gene screening for HRAS mutation
outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit for respiratory distress
Possible cavernous mass lesion and small arachnoid cyst on brain MRI
Postnatal gene-targeted testing confirmed CS diagnosis with pathogenic variants
Gastrostomy tube placement due to persistent difficulty with oral feeding
cohort: A single case of a 38-year-old pregnant woman and her infant diagnosed with Costello syndrome.
finding: This is the first reported case of prenatally diagnosed Costello syndrome via maternal blood testing, which allowed for preparedness for potential postnatal complications.
